label: genuine
source_name: GOV.UK, Check if a text message you've received from HMRC is genuine (Tax refund — P800)
text:
HMRC
We wrote to you about a tax refund (P800) for the 2025 to 2026 tax year and have not had a response. You're due a refund of £214.60. To claim your refund, search 'claim a tax refund' on GOV.UK. HMRC will never ask for personal or financial information by text.
notes: Written by us from the public template or description at source_url for the false-positive hunt (2026-09-30). Names, numbers and references are placeholders; official contacts are the ones the organisation publishes. Not a verbatim copy of a real message.
